tidal_water_definition.regulatory_basis: Md. Code Regs. 08.02.01.09 - Dividing Lines; Tidal and Nontidal Waters
tidal_water_definition.purpose: Delineates which license required (nontidal vs Chesapeake Bay/Coastal)
tidal_water_definition.boundary_lines: Established at specific geographic points throughout Maryland's rivers and creeks
tidal_water_definition.requirement: Recreational fishing in tidal waters requires Chesapeake Bay and Coastal Sport Fishing License

example_boundary_locations: Fishing Creek - 1.5 miles upstream from mouth at Chesapeake Beach
Hall's Creek - Bridge on MD Route 4
Hellen Creek - Mill Branch Road near Solomons
Hunting Creek - Bridge on MD Route 263 about 100 yards west of MD Route 4

august_closure.status: Closed to all striped bass targeting

atlantic_ocean_coastal.waters: Atlantic Ocean, coastal bays, and tributaries

recreational_crabbing_license.requirement: Required for using trotline, collapsible traps, net rings, seines, eel pots
recreational_crabbing_license.exemption: Youth under 16 with handlines/dip nets only (2 dozen limit)

boat_license.allows: License holder or one person on boat to crab

season.closed_day: Wednesdays (except during weeks with state/federal holidays on Wed/Thu)

catch_limits.without_license: Limited to 24 male hard crabs OR 12 soft/male peeler crabs

pot_cull_rings: Location: exterior side panel or top panels

turtle_reduction_device.requirement: Required at each entrance/funnel in lower chamber
turtle_reduction_device.dimensions: Not larger than 1 3/4 inches high by 4 3/4 inches long

yellow_perch.2026_regulation_change: Creel limit decreased to 5 per person per day
yellow_perch.waters: All tidal waters and nontidal rivers and streams

catfish_tidal.note: Includes blue catfish, channel catfish, flathead catfish

atlantic_striped_bass.standard_limit: 1 fish per person per day (19-24 inch slot)

tidal_water_boundary_info.importance: Critical for determining correct license type
